items.title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely.

items.title: Reimagining advertising with AI
items.lead_paragraph: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

items.title: How to connect AI usage to business value
items.lead_paragraph: Learn how ChatGPT Work and Codex analytics help teams understand AI usage and spend, identify training needs, and connect adoption to business outcomes.

items.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.

items.title: How workers are unlocking new ways of working
items.lead_paragraph: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.

items.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
items.lead_paragraph: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.

items.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
items.lead_paragraph: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

items.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
items.lead_paragraph: Learn how OpenAI evolved Habitat from a Python library into a globally distributed storage platform serving 1 billion ChatGPT users and 22M requests per second.

items.title: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
items.lead_paragraph: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.

items.title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
items.lead_paragraph: César de la Fuente’s lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections.

items.title: Now everyone can put data to work
items.lead_paragraph: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
items.lead_paragraph: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services, combining built-in financial data and GPT-6 Astra for research, modeling, and client-ready materials.

items.title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI and GSA will offer eligible federal, state, local, and tribal governments $0 license fees, 50% off usage, and expanded cyber defense support.

items.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
items.lead_paragraph: GPT‑Live‑1 brings natural, full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and telephony support.

items.title: Introducing the Agents API
items.lead_paragraph: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.

Introducing Claude Corps

items.lead_paragraph: Claude Corps is a national fellowship for early-career people passionate about extending the benefits of AI to communities across America.

items.title: Developing nuclear safeguards for AI through public-private partnership
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: With the NNSA and DOE national labs, we co-developed a classifier that distinguishes concerning from benign nuclear conversations with 96% accuracy.

items.title: Higher education advisory board and AI Fluency courses
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Anthropic announces a Higher Education Advisory Board chaired by Rick Levin and three Creative Commons AI Fluency courses for institutions.

items.title: National Security and Public Sector Advisory Council
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Eleven former senators and senior defense, intelligence, and energy officials will help identify high-impact AI applications for US security.

items.title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: August 2025
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Anthropic's August 2025 threat intelligence report on AI cybercrime and other abuses.

items.title: Updates to Consumer Terms and Privacy Policy
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Claude Free, Pro, and Max users can now opt in to having conversations used to improve models, with a five-year retention period for participants.

items.title: Anthropic raises $13B Series F at $183B valuation
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Anthropic has completed a $13 billion Series F led by ICONIQ, co-led by Fidelity and Lightspeed, valuing the company at $183 billion post-money.

items.title: Updating sales restrictions for unsupported regions
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Anthropic is tightening restrictions to bar entities majority-owned by companies headquartered in unsupported regions.

items.title: Anthropic joins White House AI education pledge
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Anthropic signs White House pledge investing in AI education for America's youth, supporting AI students and educators nationwide.

items.title: Strengthening safeguards with US CAISI and UK AISI
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Government red-teamers tested Constitutional Classifiers on Claude Opus 4 and 4.1, uncovering vulnerabilities that strengthened our safeguards.

items.title: Chris Ciauri named Managing Director of International
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Chris Ciauri joins Anthropic as Managing Director of International, adding to our global leadership team as we expand our worldwide presence.

items.title: Deloitte brings Claude to 470,000 people
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Deloitte will make Claude available across its global network, Anthropic's largest enterprise AI deployment to date.

items.title: Rahul Patil joins as Chief Technology Officer
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Rahul Patil brings 20+ years of infrastructure experience from Stripe, AWS, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud to lead engineering at Anthropic.

items.title: Anthropic expands to India with Bengaluru office
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Anthropic will open a Bengaluru office in early 2026, its second APAC location, and improve Claude's support for major Indic languages.

items.title: Salesforce and Anthropic expand partnership
items.author: Anthropic
items.lead_paragraph: Claude becomes a preferred model in Salesforce's Agentforce for regulated industries.
